errors.evidence: The description does not mention the title of the chart, which is 'Библиографски данни за изданието' (Bibliographic data for the edition).
The description uses the singular form 'страница' (page) for a category label, while the chart shows the plural form 'страници' (pages).

errors.text_span: а най-ниските стълбове са за „друго (посочете какво)“ (2) и „ISBN“ (1)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the bars with the lowest values. The lowest value is 1, which applies to three categories: 'ISBN', 'eISBN', and one of the 'друго' categories. The description omits two of these and incorrectly includes a category with a value of 2 in its list of the lowest.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са подредени по азбучен ред по вертикалната ос
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the bars are sorted alphabetically. The categories on the vertical axis are not in alphabetical order; for example, 'автор' (author) is listed above 'заглавие на изданието' (title of the edition), but 'з' comes after 'а' in the Cyrillic alphabet.
